title: 'I'll get her killed': Uttarakhand minister Rekha Arya's husband in explosive audio
content: In a shocking turn of events, Rekha Arya, a cabinet minister in Uttarakhand, has lodged a police complaint against her husband, Girdhari Lal Sahu, alleging serious offenses such as physical assault, forgery, and plotting her murder. Arya disclosed recordings in which Sahu reportedly reveals intentions to cause her harm, amplifying her concerns.

title: Court tells US to process Green Card applications for up to 55,000 people by these dates
content: A federal judge has ordered the reopening of the diversity visa lottery for 2027, allowing 55,000 applicants. The ruling came after a lawsuit filed against Secretary of State Marco Rubio regarding the lottery's registration. Judge Jinsook Ohta mandated a 30-day registration period for submissions, which must meet eligibility requirements. Additionally, new policy changes require some applicants to return to their home countries for Green Card processing.

title: Rainbow roads lose sheen as skid scare forces safety fixes
content: As Kolkata gears up for Durga Puja, an innovative road painting initiative has sparked safety debates. Reports of motorbikes skidding on the freshly colored Chingrighata flyover during rain have raised alarms. To address this, city officials have deployed mechanical scrubbers to adjust road surfaces and improve safety. Authorities promise a thorough inspection of paint quality to prevent future mishaps while implementing speed monitoring for safer travel.

title: Barbra Streisand’s $10m gift now helps provide heart care to 1,700 women a year
content: Barbra Streisand's generous donation of $10 million to Cedars-Sinai has paved the way for the creation of the Women’s Heart Center. This groundbreaking facility aims to delve into the disparities in cardiovascular health among women, addressing unique diagnostic and treatment challenges. Annually, over 1,700 women benefit from specialized cardiac care, emphasizing tailored medical approaches for heart disease, ultimately showcasing the critical need for research in women's health.

title: ‘Batting till No.8 is not bravery’: Ex-India batter slams Iyer’s team selection
content: Following India's defeat against West Indies, Mohammad Kaif expressed his apprehensions concerning the team's selection strategy. He emphasized that the bowling attack was inadequate throughout the series, leading to a failure in containing the West Indies' strong batting. Kaif also pointed out that Kuldeep Yadav's omission created an imbalance in the team, which is crucial as the series now stands at 2-2 with a decisive match upcoming.

title: A mothership for drones, a testbed for weapons: What INS Samarthak brings to Indian Navy
content: INS Samarthak has been commissioned as a multi-purpose vessel by the Indian Navy at the Karwar naval base. The ship, with various operational capabilities, is designed to support future Navy missions and technology trials. It can be utilized for tasks ranging from humanitarian assistance to maritime surveillance and environmental protection. Developed by Larsen and Toubro, this vessel significantly incorporates indigenous content in its construction.

title: US holds secret Myanmar talks as rare earth minerals at stake
content: Renewed talks between the U.S. and Myanmar's military-backed rulers signal strategic interests in rare-earth resources. These discussions focused on securing the release of an American businessman and addressing online scams. Engagement follows Myanmar's civil war, which has led to extensive displacement and control challenges. Myanmar's Kachin State is crucial for heavy rare-earth minerals but is fraught with conflict.

title: Meet Aneeshwar Kunchala, 11, set to receive Jane Goodall Earth Medal
content: Aneeshwar Kunchala, a passionate young wildlife educator, is set to receive the prestigious Junior Jane Goodall Earth Medal in 2026. His journey into conservation began at just four years old when he learned about the devastating effects of plastic on whales. Celebrated for his remarkable contributions to wildlife advocacy through media, he has initiated citizen science projects and engaging educational presentations that inspire children to connect with nature.

title: Accenture CEO says company is absorbing gains as AI & data workforce grows to 110,000
content: Accenture is increasing its artificial intelligence workforce to enhance productivity and prepare for future growth. CEO Julie Sweet outlined plans for revenue growth in the coming years, targeting mid to high-single-digit percentages. The company aims to modernize clients' technology systems while focusing on mid-sized businesses starting fiscal year 2027. Accenture has budgeted around $8 billion for acquisitions over the next year.

title: New Jersey girl, 10, reaches national poetry contest top 10 from thousands of entries
content: A 10-year-old girl from New Jersey has been named among the Top 10 winners of Creative Communication’s national poetry contest. Luisa Gonzalez’s poem, All Stitched Together, was selected from thousands of entries. Inspired by the Colombian flag, the poem reflects her cultural identity and pride in her heritage. She had previously received honourable mentions in the competition.

title: The next rest stop is 40 min away: Should you hold your pee or find a toilet now?
content: Traveling can be exhilarating, but holding your urine might come at a cost. Ignoring bathroom breaks not only leads to discomfort but can also create chronic urinary issues. To prevent struggles with bladder control, ensure you take regular restroom stops and maintain hydration. Keep an eye on caffeine as well, since it may escalate urgency. If symptoms linger, consult a doctor to safeguard your bladder health.

title: FUBU founder Daymond John turned $40 fabric budget into brand with $6bn-plus sales
content: Daymond John started FUBU with a small investment and his mother's support in the early 1990s. He sold handmade hats in Queens and quickly generated significant sales, showing demand for the brand. After facing multiple rejections from banks, his mother provided financial backing through a second mortgage. Collaborating with musicians like LL Cool J helped boost the brand's visibility and credibility.

title: India’s No. 8 obsession: Why Kuldeep Yadav is caught in the crossfire
content: For over a year, attention has centered on the struggling No. 8 batting position, an area that has failed to deliver consistent results. Nitish Kumar Reddy and Naman Dhir have been experimented with, yet their talents remain largely untapped. The team grapples with achieving the right balance due to the lack of a competent all-rounder.

title: 'Drishyam 3' BO Day 15 [LIVE]: Eyes elusive Rs 350 crore India net mark
content: 'Drishyam 3: The Conclusion' has completed two weeks in theatres and is now into its third Friday. Ajay Devgn's thriller collected Rs 4.25 crore net on Day 14, a Thursday, across 10,809 shows, which took the India net to Rs 333 crore and the India gross to Rs 399.05 crore. Overseas, Rs 1 crore on the same day lifted the overseas gross to Rs 116 crore and the worldwide gross to Rs 515.05 crore. The Rs. 400 crore India gross mark is about to fall, with Rs. 350 crore India net and Rs. 525 crore worldwide the next targets.

title: SBI ordered to pay retired scientist Rs 15L after failing to inform about FD maturity
content: A retired scientist took legal action against State Bank of India for failing to inform him about his deposit's maturity. The consumer commission determined that SBI did not communicate properly regarding the deposit and extension options. As a result, the commission found SBI had retained his funds without justification after maturity. The commission ordered the bank to pay him the original deposit amount along with interest.

title: ‘Pehle vote gaya, phir jhuggi gayi’: Delhi hearing flags SIR deletions, discrepancies
content: Many voters in Delhi, including a former MP and a teacher, expressed grievances about deletion from electoral rolls. Multiple individuals reported missing names despite submitting relevant documents and fulfilling enrollment processes. The recent hearings highlighted significant discrepancies in voter eligibility criteria, particularly affecting marginalized communities. Independent commissions recommend public verification of electoral rolls to rectify inaccuracies before finalization.

title: Bihar excise staffer shot by smugglers during chase
content: Ram Kumar Singh was shot dead outside his house in Kanakpuri locality by four armed men. His family alleged that a land dispute motivated the attack, and he had received threats previously. Sushila Devi, his wife, claimed that police did not act on earlier complaints against the accused. Following the murder, locals protested, leading to the suspension of a police officer for inaction.

title: Sonipat’s golden harvest: How Haryana city became India’s medal factory
content: Sonipat athletes shone brightly at the recent Asian Games, bringing home multiple gold medals. The unwavering support from their families, who made significant sacrifices, was instrumental in helping these athletes chase their dreams. Additionally, local sports institutions offered vital training and resources, enabling their talents to blossom. This collective community encouragement is solidifying Sonipat's reputation as a rising sports hub in India.

title: Tech Mahindra jumps 8%, IT firm adds Rs 11,000 crore to market cap after Q2 earnings
content: Tech Mahindra witnessed an impressive surge of over 8% in its shares following the announcement of remarkable quarterly earnings. The IT giant recorded a 32.74% year-on-year increase in consolidated net profit, buoyed by robust volume growth and effective cost management. In celebration of its 40th anniversary, the company also proposed a bonus issue.

title: Joni Mitchell becomes US citizen at 82, six decades after moving from Canada
content: At 82, Joni Mitchell, the iconic Canadian singer-songwriter, has officially become a United States citizen. She shared her joyous moment of naturalization via social media, reminiscing about her journey since moving to the US in 1965. This milestone not only recognizes her profound impact on American music but also grants her the privilege of voting in US elections, solidifying her bond with the country she has long called home.

title: Jack Dorsey spent $31.9m buying two neighbouring San Francisco homes
content: Twitter co-founder Jack Dorsey has made bold moves in the real estate market, acquiring two stunning properties in the upscale Sea Cliff neighborhood of San Francisco. His first investment of $9.99 million sparked an extensive redevelopment that aims to create a serene wellness retreat, prioritizing privacy and a connection to nature. Following this, he invested $21.9 million in a neighboring property, expanding his sanctuary amidst the ongoing renovation's intricate progress.

title: Indiana teen brothers rescue grandmother and 2 children from retention pond
content: During a tense moment in Carmel, Indiana, two brothers displayed extraordinary bravery by rescuing a grandmother and her grandchildren from a pond. Their ordeal began when a pushchair slipped into the water, triggering panic. The older brother dove in, employing life-saving measures that successfully revived a two-year-old boy who had momentarily lost consciousness. The brothers will receive community recognition for their courageous actions at the next city council meeting.

title: 3 videos, Nepal ‘location’ and a ‘mysterious sir’: Hunt on for influencer Shraddha Dubey
content: Businessman Shiva Sharma died after falling from a building, with his partner Shraddha Dubey accused of involvement. Videos surfaced showing Dubey confronting Sharma over alleged theft before his death. Sharma's family claims Dubey pushed him, while she asserts he died by suicide. Police have extended their search for Dubey and her associates to Nepal after they went missing.

title: In Claude We Trust: Can 'God' save the machine?
content: In this edition, we are going to look at how Anthropic is now hoping to get a little spiritual cred for its frontier models, and by doing so, they are channelling the kings of yore, who, despite their armies and gold, always wanted a divine mandate to rule. And will then ponder: how will we ever know when a machine becomes conscious?

title: Air India cancels all flights to and from three Saudi cities till October 20
content: In response to the escalating conflict, Air India has halted all flights to and from Saudi Arabia until October 20. This decision aligns with similar suspensions by other carriers such as Air France-KLM and Gulf Air. Affected passengers will receive refunds, as the airline prioritizes safety amidst growing operational costs, further amplified by the ongoing turbulence in the Middle East that disrupts travel and markets alike.

title: ‘Only Modi can tour’: Denied foreign trip 4th time, Mann moves court
content: Punjab's Chief Minister, Bhagwant Mann, is experiencing ongoing refusals for political clearance regarding his international trips, including a previously approved appearance at a food festival in Paris that was later blocked. His request to attend hockey matches in Japan was also denied. The Aam Aadmi Party alleges these actions reflect political bias against Punjab, contrasting with Haryana's Chief Minister, Nayab Singh Saini, who enjoys swift approvals for foreign engagements.

title: Britain-sized Doomsday Glacier is melting faster than feared
content: Recent findings show that Thwaites Glacier might be a far bigger player in sea-level rise than previously thought. As warm ocean waters intrude beneath its icy surface, the glacier is melting at an alarming rate. If this trend persists, we could see a catastrophic detachment from the Mouginot Ridge by the year 2100.

title: India and Russia begin naval wargame INDRA in Russian waters
content: India and Russia are set to conduct Exercise INDRA from October 13 to 18, 2026. The Indian Navy's INS Sahyadri arrived at Vladivostok for the exercise, which includes naval and harbour-based engagements. This series of exercises aims to enhance mutual understanding and interoperability between the two navies. The INDRA exercise reflects the growing defense cooperation between India and Russia.

title: Elon Musk's monopoly charge, Reliance's response: What's the Starlink-Jio row all about?
content: Reliance Industries has welcomed the entry of Elon Musk's Starlink into the Indian satellite communications market. The company clarified that it has never feared competition and is also awaiting clearances for its satellite services. Musk has alleged that Reliance benefits from monopolistic practices and has questioned regulatory barriers. The Indian government has stated that all companies must comply with existing laws and security requirements.

title: Another Kuki woman killed in Manipur ambush
content: Hatneikim Haokip, a Kuki-Zo woman, was killed in an ambush by suspected Naga militants in Manipur. Her husband was injured during the attack, which also left two other community members missing. This incident marks the continuing ethnic violence that has escalated in the state. Manipur's government officials emphasized the need for dialogue to resolve conflicts and maintain peace. Security forces are working to enhance security, particularly along the India-Myanmar border.

title: Remove Gautam as Sikkim governor in 24 hrs or face stir: Murder victim’s father

Following their detention by Delhi Police, they vowed to intensify their efforts if their demands are not met. Congress leaders, including Rahul Gandhi, supported the family's protest and urged for Gautam's removal during the ongoing investigation.

title: US administration plans $335,000 ad campaign as Afrikaner refugee interest falls short

title: Israeli firm used online ads to run vast spy operation, researchers say
content: its services gave Israeli spyware firm and other surveillance companies access to ad platforms run by Google, Comcast, Yandex and others . the online advertising industry, already under scrutiny over privacy, could serve as a channel for extensive espionage . its ads reached more than 120,000 websites and 75,000 apps through its partnerships .

title: 'Don’t trust anybody': Trump's response to Netanyahu question ahead of Israel polls
content: "in the world of politics I don’t trust anybody," Trump tells newsmax . he says he does not trust anyone in politics when asked about israel's prime minister Benjamin Netanyahu . "they’d like me to be. Yeah, they'd like him to be," he said .

title: 'You might want to explain unless you want me to': Rahul's cryptic post over Rubio visit
content: a leader of opposition in Lok Sabha questioned pm Narendra Modi . he alleges that officials in the external affairs ministry are "confused" about the developments . the remarks came a day after congress questioned the Centre’s silence on Rubio’s visit .

title: Watch: China-North Korea bridge opens after 12-years delay
content: new Yalu River bridge connects Dandong in northeastern china with Sinuiju in north Korea . the bridge is reviving a major trade route after more than a decade of stalled construction and signalling renewed efforts to strengthen economic ties . china and north Korea officially opened the bridge on friday .

title: Trans teen accused of Hindu temple attack plot to receive hormone shots in jail
content: a 19-year-old transgender man from Palatine, Illinois, is accused of plotting a racist mass shooting at a Hindu temple near Chicago . he is being treated for attention-deficit/hyperactivity disorder (ADHD), depression and anxiety, in addition to receiving hormone injections . the ruling comes days after Paporakis was arrested over an alleged plan to attack a temple in Aurora, a suburb of Chicago, .

title: Virginia acquires 2,211 acres to protect trout streams and create conservation area
